title: HB47 (2020 Regular): Public Safety - Handgun Qualification License - Training Exemption

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Maryland) (gun-policy Stage 5, Maryland); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Mississippi text (First Reader; official copy, https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/2020RS/bills/hb/hb0047f.pdf)

operative_text: Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-117.1(e)): (e) An applicant for a handgun qualification license is not required to complete a firearms safety training course under subsection (d) of this section if the applicant: ... (6) lawfully owns a regulated firearm; OR (7) IS A LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICER WITH A LAW ENFORCEMENT AGENCY IN DELAWARE, PENNSYLVANIA, VIRGINIA, WEST VIRGINIA, OR WASHINGTON, D.C.
